2645-3181-3430-6256.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3181-3430-6256.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Muraganda Raceway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

483-2577-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
483-2577-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

955-2023-4289-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

728-4871-5626-6415.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Wriggling Grub.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

225-851-1308-4365-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1170-1329-4708-7895.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Dark Sphere.
Cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Little Bear.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

855-2021-2060-3062.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

4496-5220-5708-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

618-4456-6898-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Electro and Hematite Talisman trigger.
Resolve the Electro trigger, adding {R}
Resolve the Hematite Talisman trigger, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

1362-3259-6628--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1362-3259-6628--85--106.description:
Activate PuPu UFO's first activated ability by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1394-2034-2060-5902-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Innkeeper's Talent.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

413-465-5987.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

1144-2645-3512-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

5147-5170-6132-6273.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4772-5448-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4772-5448-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Druid Class
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-3980.description:
Activate Sisay's Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Sisay's Ring.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Sisay's Ring.
Repeat.

437-3755-4222.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2541-4869-6824.notablePrerequisites:
Glint-Horn Buccaneer has lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
2541-4869-6824.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1089-4968-6822.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat.

4593-4659-5789-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Lifecreed Duo triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4593-4659-5789-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

6339-6712-6781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that has haste and/or flash.
6339-6712-6781.description:
Cast Rootborn Defenses by paying {2}{W}, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Shaman by sacrificing an artifact, dealing 1 damage to each creature without flying.
Sonic's second ability triggers for each creature you control with haste or flash that was dealt damage, creating that many tapped Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1563-2457-3499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

325-2498-5437-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2498-5437-6282.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat.

413-2961-6553.easyPrerequisites: False Demise attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
413-2961-6553.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

955-1563-2457-2557.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1309-1987-2104-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1309-1987-2104-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

261-1461-4050-4078.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
261-1461-4050-4078.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-2169-2831.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}, causing each creature you control to enter the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glen Elendra Archmage, adding {C}{C}.
Glen Elendra Archmage dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

193-703-1434.notablePrerequisites: Aminatou has at least two loyalty counters on it.
193-703-1434.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Astral Dragon.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, creating two token copies of Aminatou that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Aminatou tokens, you may instead activate their first ability for infinite draw triggers.

232-3398-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Priest of Urabrask does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Priest of Urabrask and Hellkite Charger.
232-3398-4711.description:
Declare Priest of Urabrask as an attacker.
Hellkite Charger, Hellkite Charger's myriad ability, and Priest of Urabrask' myriad ability trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, creating at least three token copies of it that are tapped and attacking.
The Priest of Urabrask tokens enter the battlefield, adding at least nine {R}.
Resolve Hellkite Charger's myriad trigger, creating at least three token copies of it that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the remaining Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Blade of Selves triggers, exiling the Priest of Urabrask tokens.
Repeat each combat phase.

141-1409-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three lands.
141-1409-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Naru Meha by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Naru Meha enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

2367-3490-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a creature, adding {R}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create a 1/1 Servo creature token.
Repeat.
